## Biography

I am a mathematics graduate currently enrolled in the Data Engineering program at Politecnico di Torino. My background bridges theoretical mathematical rigor with applied computational engineering: after completing my Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Mathematics at the University of Pisa, I completed a 1-year Master's in Mathematical and Physical Methods for Engineering (MPM) at the University of Turin (UniTO), where I worked on 3D computer vision and deep learning during an internship at Leonardo Velivoli.

I am actively seeking opportunities in data engineering, machine learning, and data science where I can apply mathematical problem-solving and scalable software engineering to real-world data systems.
